purpose: Pins the official KoSIT tooling that the local development harness (tools/kosit/validate.ts) accepts. Nothing listed here is committed to the repository: the bundle is supplied through the ORKAID_KOSIT_BUNDLE environment variable and extracted into the git-ignored .cache/ directory after its hashes are verified.

bundle.source: Official XRechnung bundle of the Koordinierungsstelle fuer IT-Standards (KoSIT), https://xeinkauf.de/xrechnung/ . The hash identifies the distribution that was inspected locally; it is not an upstream signature.
